children.text: 淹没城区 1：你进入海底圆顶时，噼啪作响的电流声迎面而来。被水淹没的沟壑与崩塌的废墟覆盖着海床上这片圆形广场。无论怎么努力，你的目光总是不由自主地飘向异星屏障之外的大海。一群水母在幽暗的深水中梦幻地漂浮。若那能量场因任何原因消失，远征队必定会被席卷而去。
查看你的战役日志。
若远征队向西进发，前往淹没城区 2。
若远征队向东进发，跳至淹没城区 3。

淹没城区 2：“我想这就是源头，”安迪指着广场中央的圆形建筑。电光舔舐着上方闪烁的泡膜。这座建筑正是光芒的来源，想必也是保护这些废墟免受海水侵袭的能量场来源。在里面，你发现了一台旋转的星盘仪：由悬浮的球体与嗡嗡转动的齿轮构成的复杂机械，搅动着持续不断的电流。其核心锁着一颗炽热发光的宝珠。安迪紧张地坐立不安。“它在给这台机器供能。我不知道我们把它取出来会发生什么，但……这看起来像是蒂林哈斯特先生会想要的东西。”
你还没来得及反对，他已经动手操作起那些古老的控制装置。也许有办法取出宝珠而不被淹没……
淹没城区 3：你跟随远征队穿过深水坑与沉没废墟，来到那光芒——想必也是那能量场——的源头。在其中，你发现了一台旋转的星盘仪：由悬浮的球体与嗡嗡转动的齿轮构成的复杂机械，搅动着持续不断的电流。其核心锁着一颗炽热发光的宝珠。露比倒吸一口气。“这是某种泵站。我敢打赌那颗宝珠是它重要的一部分。偷走它可能会让整个大海砸到我们头上。”她痞气地笑了。“所以你最好准备好跑路。”
你还没来得及反对，她已经动手操作起那些古老的控制装置。也许有办法取走宝珠而不被淹没……
若有调查员拥有“没有比家更好的地方”任务，他们在下一页结算各自的故事。
前往设置。

children.title: 任务：没有比家更好的地方

children.text: 仅当你拥有“没有比家更好的地方”任务时阅读：
你抬头望向那异星星盘仪，头晕目眩。这景象把你带回了那一夜——蒂林哈斯特把你从街头带走的那一夜。那晚的星星很明亮，你忘不了它们那特别的排布，正是此刻你眼前所见的排布。远离阿卡姆生活中无尽的劳碌与烦忧，你想了很多。蒂林哈斯特的话很和善，但语气却严厉、冷漠、没有感情。回想起来，你只有在有用的时候才得到过这位商人的关注。他的行为中没有善意；他救你的时候，只是把你这又一个欠债人收进了自己的箭囊。
这已经是你第无数次“最后一票”了。蒂林哈斯特真的值得信任吗？
你必须决定（选择一项）：
“蒂林哈斯特先生一直待我很好。我信任他。”从你的调查员身上治疗 1 点精神创伤或 1 点肉体创伤。在你的战役日志中擦除没有比家更好的地方下的 1 点进度。
“我只能靠自己。我没有人可以信任。”在你的战役日志中没有比家更好的地方下标记 2 点进度，并受到 1 点精神创伤。每名调查员在下一个剧本开始时，起始手牌减少 2 张。
从以下遭遇组中收集所有卡牌：淹没城区、异界机械、宇宙遗产、深潜者、古老迷雾、洪水、拉莱耶与海底生物。这些组以下列图标表示：
“淹没城区”的地点布置
将屏障核心放入游戏，（未激活）面朝上。
收集每个海床地点，并随机将一份珊瑚礁和一份淹没卫城移出游戏。
将其余八个海床地点洗混，按照地点布置图以 3x3 网格放入游戏，环绕屏障核心。
每名调查员从屏障核心开始游戏。
将屏障节点剧情支援以及双面的水下寄生虫 [runeX] 和黑曜石遗物 [runeY] 卡放在一边，置于场外。
按玩家顺序，每名玩家可以选择 1 张已获得的神器支援，或远征遭遇组中的 1 张物品支援，以在其控制下开始游戏。该组以下列图标表示：
将洪水标记加入标记池，并查看你的战役日志。
若远征队向东进发，升起的城市震动了古老圆顶。提高 1 [per_investigator] 个海床地点的洪水等级。
洗混其余的遭遇卡，组建遭遇牌库。
你现在可以开始游戏了。
因深入研究淹没城区

resolutions.title: 结局 1
resolutions.text:
结局 1：那奇异的节点在你手中脉动，投射出柔软的光泡，挡住了坠落的瓦砾。圆顶如气泡般爆裂时，你冲到了入口。远征队怀着敬畏与恐惧交织的心情，看着海水洪流重新夺回那座异星建筑。一阵刺痛穿过你的手掌，你低头看见节点正埋入你的掌心，蛛网状的黑丝在你的皮肤下辐射开来。当你把节点拉走时，那些黑丝无痛地缩了回去。蒂林哈斯特一定会为这次发现而高兴。

• 在你战役日志的“已获得的神器”部分，勾选“屏障节点”旁的方框。

• 跳至结局 3。

resolutions.title: 结局 2
resolutions.text:
结局 2：重新激活的核心迅速处理了被淹没的圆顶，短短几分钟内就排干了水。你和远征队沿着这座沉没遗迹的周界巡视，惊叹于它古老的宏伟。走在干燥的海床上、看着鱼群在闪烁的泡膜外掠过，感觉就像梦中的景象。几个小时后，远征队继续前进。

• 在你的战役日志中记录能量被转移了。

• 每名调查员因深入研究淹没城区而获得 2 点奖励经验。

• 前往结局 3。

resolutions.title: 结局 3
resolutions.text:
结局 3：保护通往城市那条隧道的能量场依然稳固。随着城市升起，拉莱耶参差的地基不断碎裂坠落。是时候继续前进了。

• 在你的战役日志中，将拉莱耶地图上的“淹没城区”划掉。

• 每名调查员获得的经验等于胜利区每张卡的胜利 X 值。

resolutions.title: 无结局
resolutions.text:
若无结局（每名调查员都撤退或被击败）：在圆顶入口的另一侧，你透过薄如轻纱的屏障望向海床。大海在短短几秒内就重新夺回了那座异星圆顶。你没有被卷走，简直是个小小的奇迹。

• 你的失败使你偏离了目标。每名调查员必须擦除自己任务下的 1 点进度（若能够）。

• 跳至结局 3。

children.text: The Drowned Quarter 1: The sound of crackling electricity greets you as you enter the undersea dome. Flooded trenches and crumbling ruins cover the round plaza on the seafloor. Try as you might, your eyes keep drifting to the ocean beyond the alien barrier. A bloom of jellyfish floats dreamily through the tenebrous depths. If the energy field were to disappear for any reason, the expedition would surely be swept away.
Check your Campaign Log.
If the expedition headed west, proceed to The Drowned Quarter 2.
If the expedition headed east, skip to The Drowned Quarter 3.

The Drowned Quarter 2: “I think this is the source,” Andy points to the round structure in the center of the plaza. Bolts of electricity lick the shimmering bubble above. The structure is the source of the glow and, presumably, the energy field protecting these ruins from the ocean water. Inside, you find a spinning orrery: a complex mechanism of hovering spheres and whirring gears that stir a constant electric current. Locked at its core is an incandescent orb. Andy fidgets nervously. “It’s powering the machine. I don’t know what’ll happen if we take it out but…it looks like something Mr. Tillinghast would want.”
Before you can object, he sets to operating the ancient controls. There may be a way to remove the orb without drowning…

The Drowned Quarter 3: You follow the expedition past pits of deep water and sunken ruins to the source of the glow and, presumably, the energy field. Inside it, you find a spinning orrery: a complex mechanism of hovering spheres and whirring gears that stir a constant electric current. Locked at its core is an incandescent orb. Ruby gasps. “It’s some kind of pumping station. I’d wager that orb is an important part of it. It’s possible that stealing it could bring the ocean down on our heads.” She smiles rakishly. “So you’d better be ready to run.”
Before you can object, she sets to operating the ancient controls. There may be a way to take the orb without drowning…
If an investigator has the No Place Like Home Task, they resolve their respective story on the following page.
Proceed to Setup.
Read only if you have the No Place Like Home Task:

Your head spins as you look up at the alien orrery. The sight brings you back to that first night, the night Tillinghast took you off the streets. The stars that night were bright, and you can’t forget their particular formation, the same formation in front of you now. Away from the constant grind and concerns of your life in Arkham, you’ve done some thinking. Tillinghast’s words were kind, but his tone was harsh, cold, unfeeling. Reflecting on it, you have only garnered the businessman’s attention when you were useful. There was no kindness in his act; when he saved you, he acquired you as yet another lackey in his quiver of debtors.
This is the umpteenth “last job” you’ve been on. Is Tillinghast really worth his word?
You must decide (choose one):
“Mr. Tillinghast has treated me well. I trust him.” Heal 1 mental or 1 physical trauma from your investigator. Erase 1 progress under No Place Like Home in your Campaign Log.

“I’m on my own. There’s no one I can trust.” Mark 2 progress under No Place Like Home in your Campaign Log and suffer 1 mental trauma. Each investigator begins the next scenario with 2 fewer cards in their starting hand.
Gather all cards from the following encounter sets: The Drowned Quarter, Alien Machinery, Cosmic Legacy, Deep Ones, Elder Mist, Flood, R’lyeh, and Undersea Creatures.
Location Placement for “The Drowned Quarter”
Put the Barrier Core into play, (Inactive) side faceup.
Gather each Sea Floor location and remove one copy of Coral Reef and one copy of Drowned Acropolis from the game at random.
Shuffle the eight remaining Sea Floor locations together and put them into play in a 3x3 grid around the Barrier Core as shown in the location placement diagram.
Each investigator begins play at the Barrier Core.
Set the Barrier Node story asset and the double-sided Undersea Parasite [runeX] and Obsidian Relic [runeY] cards aside, out of play.
In player order, each player may choose 1 earned Artifact asset or 1 Item asset from the Expedition encounter set to begin in play under their control. This set is indicated by the following icon:
Add the flood tokens to the token pool and check your Campaign Log.
If the expedition headed east, the rising city has shaken the ancient dome. Increase the flood level of 1 [per_investigator] Sea Floor locations.
Shuffle the remaining encounter cards to build the encounter deck.
You are now ready to begin.
因深入研究淹没城区
